# cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_rego_module (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_rego_module" "example_zero_trust_cws_rego_module" {
  account_id = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  name = "x"
  rego_source = "x"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID (32-character hexadecimal string)
- `name` (String) Name of the Rego module (unique per account)
- `rego_source` (String) Library Rego source with a package beginning with "lib." Maximum 16384 UTF-8 bytes.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID
- `package_path` (String) Dotted path derived from rego_source. Begins with lib. and is unique per account.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
$ terraform import cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_rego_module.example '<account_id>/<rego_module_id>'
```
